name: Alpidem

own_problems.text: Pulled from the market in France, first in 1993 — for liver harm

summary: Alpidem was removed from the market in France starting in 1993 because of harm to the liver [3]. A small computer model, rather than tests on people, calculated a high liver score of 78 for this medicine [M]. That same computer model also gave the drug a low heart score of 43 without testing on humans [M].
